reviews.title: No way to delete your photos (Violates Apple Guidelines)
reviews.text: This app is a privacy trap. There is absolutely no in-app button or option to delete your account or data, which is a direct violation of Apple’s developer rules. On top of that, their "30-day automatic deletion policy" is a LIE. I reinstalled the app after months and all my photos are still stored on their servers. Do not download if you care about your privacy.
